question: Which Kuchipudi dancer received National Nritya Shiromani Award 2022?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Aparna Satheesan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Aparna Satheesan** is a renowned **Kuchipudi dancer**, known for her exceptional contributions to Indian classical dance.
 
• She was honored with the **National Nritya Shiromani Award 2022** for her **outstanding achievements** in the field of classical dance and her efforts to promote Indian culture worldwide.
 
• **Kuchipudi** is a classical dance form originating in the state of **Andhra Pradesh, India**, which combines dance, music, and acting.
 
• **Aparna Satheesan** is recognized for her innovative approach, blending traditional Kuchipudi with **contemporary themes** to make it more relatable to modern audiences.
 
• She has performed extensively in **India and abroad**, gaining international acclaim and contributing to the global appreciation of Indian classical dance.
 
• The **National Nritya Shiromani Award** is a prestigious recognition given to individuals who have made significant contributions to the field of dance in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Anita Sharma**__

 __
 
• **Anita Sharma** is a renowned **Sattriya dancer** from Assam, India.
 
• **Sattriya** is one of the eight classical dance forms of India, originating in the **Vaishnavite monasteries of Assam**.
 
• She has received several accolades for her efforts to preserve and promote **Sattriya dance** and culture.
 
 
 
• **Anindita Neogy Anaam**__
 __
 
• **Anindita Neogy Anaam** is a celebrated **Kathak dancer** known for her graceful performances and dedication to the art form.
 
• **Kathak** is a classical dance form originating in **North India** and is characterized by intricate footwork and expressive gestures.
 
• She has received multiple awards for her remarkable contribution to **Kathak dance**.
 
 
 
• **Jatin Goswami**__
 
 
• **Jatin Goswami** is a prominent figure in **Sattriya dance** and choreography.
 
• He is known for his extensive work in preserving and promoting **Assamese culture** through dance and music.
 
• He has also been conferred with prestigious awards like the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award**.
